tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects available to this connection.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List starter templates and example files that create_project can use.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project, optionally from a template (see list_templates). Returns its id and editor URL.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Permanently delete a project and its stored file. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Describe a project: artboards with their object tree (ids, names, positions, colors, text), timelines with keyed properties, state machines with inputs/states, and theme colors.

tools.name: import_riv
tools.description: Import a .riv file as a new project. Use dataBase64 for remote HTTP MCP sessions; path is available only to local stdio MCP.

path.description: Absolute path to a .riv file (local stdio only)

tools.name: export_riv
tools.description: Export a project as a .riv file. Local stdio may provide path; HTTP MCP receives portable base64 bytes in the response.

path.description: Output file path (.riv), local stdio only

tools.name: inspect_riv
tools.description: Describe a .riv file. Use dataBase64 for HTTP MCP; path is available only to local stdio MCP.

tools.name: diagnose_project
tools.description: Check a project’s exported .riv for broken references, missing assets, unsupported features and byte-identical round-trip safety. Run after substantial edits and fix error-level diagnostics before delivery.

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Render a project artboard to a PNG so you can inspect visual results. Select an animation and time to preview a frame. The software renderer supports vector files; image assets, meshes and feathering require the CLI browser renderer.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

animation.description: Timeline id, name or index; omit for a static frame

tools.name: add_artboard
tools.description: Add an artboard to a project.

tools.name: add_shape
tools.description: Add a shape (rectangle, ellipse, triangle, polygon, star) centered at x,y.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: add_path
tools.description: Add a custom vector path from points (relative to x,y). Points may have bezier handles inX/inY/outX/outY (offsets from the point).

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: add_text
tools.description: Add a text object (the Inter font is embedded automatically).

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

width.description: Wrap width; omit for auto width

tools.name: add_group
tools.description: Add an empty group (Node) that other objects can be nested in via their parent.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: set_properties
tools.description: Set design properties on an object, e.g. {"x":10,"opacity":0.5,"rotationDegrees":45,"fill":"#ff0000","text":"Hi","fontSize":24,"width":100}.

tools.name: delete_objects
tools.description: Delete objects (and their children and keyframes).

tools.name: convert_vertex_type
tools.description: Convert a path vertex between straight and cubic handle types while preserving skin weights.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: add_clip
tools.description: Clip an object and its children to another shape on the same artboard. The mask shape must be outside the clipped object.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

object.description: Object id or name to clip

tools.name: remove_clip
tools.description: Remove one clip mask or every mask from an object.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

clipId.description: Specific clipping shape id; omit to remove every mask

tools.name: add_timeline
tools.description: Add a timeline (linear animation) to an artboard.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: add_keyframes
tools.description: Key one property of an object in a timeline. Properties: x, y, rotationDegrees, scaleX, scaleY, opacity, width, height, fill, stroke, fontSize, cornerRadiusTL, ... Values for fill/stroke are colors.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

themeColor.description: Use a theme color for color properties

ease.description: Interpolation to the next key (default easeInOut) or a cubic bezier [x1,y1,x2,y2]

tools.name: apply_edit_plan
tools.description: Apply a sequence of up to 100 design, animation and interaction operations with one project save. All operations succeed together or none are saved. Within the plan, later steps can reference objects and timelines by the names assigned in earlier steps.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)
Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)
Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)
Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)
Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: add_state_machine
tools.description: Add a state machine (with entry / any / exit states).

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: add_input
tools.description: DEPRECATED: add a state machine input. Rive deprecated inputs — prefer add_property, which works everywhere inputs did and more. Only use this for a file that must keep its existing inputs.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

stateMachine.description: State machine id or name (default: first)

tools.name: add_property
tools.description: Add a data binding property to the artboard (what replaces state machine inputs). Transitions can read it, listeners can set it, and runtimes get and set it on the view model instance.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: set_property_value
tools.description: Set the value a data binding property starts with.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: convert_inputs_to_data_binding
tools.description: Rewrite a file's deprecated state machine inputs as data binding properties: conditions read the property, listeners set it, and the inputs are removed. Reports anything that had to keep its input.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

stateMachine.description: State machine id or name (default: first)

tools.name: add_state
tools.description: Add a state that plays a timeline.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

stateMachine.description: State machine id or name (default: first)

tools.name: add_bone
tools.description: Add a root bone at an artboard position, or a child bone at the tip of a parent bone. Rotation is in radians.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

parent.description: Parent bone for a chained bone

tools.name: bind_skin
tools.description: Bind every vertex on a PointsPath or Mesh to the selected bones in its current bind pose. Vertex weights can then be edited in the OpenRive inspector.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

path.description: PointsPath or Mesh id or name

tools.name: set_skin_weights
tools.description: Set normalized point or independent cubic-handle weights. Tendon indices are 1-based; 0 is unbound.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: auto_weight_skin
tools.description: Assign up to four nearby bone influences per point and cubic handle.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: smooth_skin_weights
tools.description: Smooth weights across adjacent contour vertices.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: rebind_skin
tools.description: Capture the current posed contour as a new bind pose while retaining weights.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: unbind_skin
tools.description: Remove a skin while keeping the current posed contour.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: set_bone_parent
tools.description: Link a bone to a parent tip, or detach to the artboard while preserving its world pose.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: paint_skin_weights
tools.description: Paint a normalized bone influence within an artboard-space brush stroke.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: add_blend_state
tools.description: Add a 1D blend state driven by a numeric state-machine parameter and a set of timelines with parameter values.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

stateMachine.description: State machine id or name (default: first)

parameter.description: Existing numeric state-machine input name or id; otherwise a new one is created

tools.name: add_transition
tools.description: Add a transition between states. from/to: "entry", "any", "exit", a state id, or a timeline name. Conditions compare data binding properties (booleans use value, numbers use op + value, triggers need only the name).

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

stateMachine.description: State machine id or name (default: first)

exitTimeMs.description: Wait until this time in the source timeline

input.description: Deprecated state machine input; a property of the same name is used when there is no such input

tools.name: add_listener
tools.description: Make an object interactive: respond to a pointer or named Rive event, set data binding properties, align a node to the pointer, or fire a named event.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

stateMachine.description: State machine id or name (default: first)

target.description: Object id or name (default: whole artboard)

input.description: Deprecated state machine input; a property of the same name is used when there is no such input

value.description: Triggers need no value; "toggle" only works with an input

alignTarget.description: Object id or name to align to the pointer

tools.name: add_event
tools.description: Create a named custom Rive event with optional number, boolean, string or color payload properties.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: rename_event
tools.description: Rename a custom event, keeping its artboard event names unique.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: remove_event
tools.description: Remove a custom event and its event payload properties and state-machine listeners/actions.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: add_distance_constraint
tools.description: Add a distance constraint from one node to another, with an optional rule and strength.

artboard.description: Artboard id or name (default: first artboard)

tools.name: define_theme_color
tools.description: Define (or update in the active theme) a named theme color.

tools.name: use_theme_color
tools.description: Bind an object's fill or stroke (or a text color) to a theme color so it follows theme changes.

tools.name: add_theme
tools.description: Add a theme (a copy of the active one) whose colors can then be changed.

tools.name: set_theme_color_value
tools.description: Change a theme color's value within a specific theme.

tools.name: switch_theme
tools.description: Make a theme active, recoloring every bound color.
